thread:
maria: RFC follow-up: canary snooze mechanics 11 sketching a 'snooze_budget' + denoise pipeline. want quick feedback on guardrails.

cheng: +1. We need explicit budget so teams can't keep extending forever. global cap + per-tenant cap.

lee: How do we charge the budget? per-extension or per-second?

maria: plan: charge wall-clock seconds. min increment 10s, bill against rollout budget. If budget hits 0 -> force rollback.

sam: For A/B experiments this must be variant-scoped. If variant B degrades we flip B only. Don't touch A.

maria: Agreed. Also policy hierarchy: variant -> region -> global. local rollbacks first.

lee: Denoising idea: don't start snooze on a single noisy window. compute a denoise_score using median-of-means + percentile downweighting. start snooze only when score > threshold.

cheng: Can we make denoise pluggable? teams may want conservative (2 windows) or aggressive (1 window + short snooze).

maria: yes pluggable strategies. config sketch:
```json
{
  "canary": {
    "enabled": true,
    "snooze_budget_seconds": 300,
    "snooze_max_contiguous_seconds": 120,
    "denoise_strategy": "median_of_means",
    "denoise_windows": 3,
    "per_variant_isolation": true
  }
}
```

sam: Ops concern: manual extension paths. If humans extend snooze we must audit who, why, and require role 'rollout.ops'. No silent extensions.

maria: Security + audit: manual extends require ACL and generate immutable audit event. We'll surface in Console.

lee: Telemetry 1: emit metrics: `snooze_budget_left_seconds`, `snooze_count`, `snooze_extend_by_seconds`, `denoise_score`. Also events: snooze_started, snooze_extended, snooze_exhausted, rollback_executed.

cheng: Runtime vs control plane: keep fast failure detectors local for low latency, but authoritative decisions and audit live in control plane. define small DecisionRT API: DecisionRequest (signal_bundle, windows, budget_left) -> DecisionResponse (action, snooze_seconds, reason).

sam: Edge-case: region-specific degradation but global healthy. prefer regional rollback. routing layer must support per-region variant weights.

maria: Yeah we'll push region-scoped actuators to routing layer. Controller returns `scope: region|variant|global` in DecisionResponse.

ops-bot: canary-scheduler:v1 deployed to staging (flag snooze=true).

lee: One more: protect experiment integrity. If snooze causes many traffic reassignments, mark experiment as "perturbed" so analytics excludes noisy windows or flags for re-run.

maria: Good call. We'll add an experiment_state flag and integrate with analytics pipeline.

cheng: Small perf note: denoise >3 windows adds latency to detection. default strategy should be conservative for infra-critical endpoints, fast for feature flags.

maria: Default: snooze off (0s). For onboarded services default conservative: denoise_windows=2, snooze_budget=180s.

sam: ops playbook snippet: on snooze alert -> check budget_left, inspect denoise_score, consult region metrics, take manual extend only if rollback would cause harm.

maria: Next: I'll draft RFC addendum with DecisionRT schema, config defaults, and example Console wiring. Will open PR and tag y'all. :thumbsup:

cheng: +1

lee: +1

sam: +1

ops-bot: canary-scheduler:v1 feature flag enabled in staging. monitoring hooks attached.
